logp.method_description: Partition coefficients were measured using PBS and 1-octanol as described by Green, et al. [8], [9] using a small aliquot (typically 20 μL) of the product and 5 mL each of PBS and 1-octanol. The small amounts of salt and ethanol present in this relatively small sample volume compared to the volumes of PBS and 1-octanol (0.2%) used in the measurement are presumed not to affect the log P measurement. This is assumption is supported by the fact that larger sample volumes (up to 50 μL) give identical results to those obtained with 20 μL samples.
